scope: Source/convention/tolerance guidance for actual future selected R36 workers. Does not append frontier, reserve budget, grant review or qualify a product.

qualification_steps: Inputs already reused and metadata-validated by separate preparation with0 new network bytes; bind exact receipt/products above. Recheck only identities needed by the actual packet; no duplicate fetch.

Verify Git blob identity and local SHA256;1701 original rows and covariance header N1701 plus2893401 finite entries. Keep original index order, CID duplicates, survey IDs and calibrator/HF flags; subset rows and both covariance axes identically.

Use m_b_corr and full STAT+SYS covariance once. m_b_corr_ERR_DIAG is display-only; no added PV/error diagonal. Retain zHEL,zCMB,zHD,VPEC/VPECERR definitions; a change of redshift convention requires a new explicit response/covariance transformation.
Use the predeclared selection/mean/design above. Profile additive magnitude calibration and depth-level nuisance; MU_SH0ES does not independently measure H0.

Use whitened intercept-profiled GLS, exact covariance cross blocks and source-bound angular/depth response. Fixed Gaussian-law tests need known full rank and predeclared scan; report leverage/leave-survey robustness, not source independence. Joint CF4 analysis additionally needs overlap/shared PV covariance.
contract.actual_unresolved_choice: Low-z/depth cuts, nuisance and angular design are now predeclared above before fitting. Physical-frame and raw-to-congruence interpretation remain source-limited; the released-coordinate conditional comparator is executable.
contract.boundary: Released-magnitude alternate; no nominal SALT2 training parity or original H04/V04 admission.
contract.preregistration_status: FROZEN_BY_SCIENTIFIC_PREPARER_BEFORE_ANY_R36_SN_FIT; actual packet and independent review still required
contract.released_coordinate_chart: Convert released RA,DEC degrees to n=(cosDEC cosRA,cosDEC sinRA,sinDEC), label axes as released RA/DEC Cartesian chart only. No independent ICRS/J2000 assertion is available in the intake receipt. Physical-frame interpretation remains held.

prespecified_selection.primary: IS_CALIBRATOR==0 and0.0233<=zHD<=0.15; finite required values. Keep every released duplicate observation and full covariance subblock in original row order. No use of USED_IN_SH0ES_HF as a second undocumented selection.
prespecified_selection.depth_bins: bin0:0.0233<=zHD<0.06; bin1:0.06<=zHD<=0.15; boundary0.06 assigned to high bin exactly.
prespecified_selection.reason: Declared low-z released-observable design, with conservative low-z exclusion and a fixed depth split overlapping the H03 tomography range. These cuts are method choices, not claims that peculiar velocity/selection effects vanish.
prespecified_selection.robustness: Exactly one prespecified lower-z sensitivity extends bin0 to0.01<=zHD<0.06, leaving upper bin and all other choices fixed. No outcome-selected further cuts, masks or axes. Report insufficient rank instead of choosing a new cut.

prespecified_mean.reference: mu_ref=5 log10[(1+zHEL)*integral_0^zHD dz/sqrt(0.3153*(1+z)^3+0.6847)]; dimensionless distance reference. The additive magnitude intercept absorbs c/H0,25 and absolute luminosity. This is a declared fixed-background conditional comparator, not a fitted physical mean law or independent H0 measurement.
prespecified_mean.observed_response: y=m_b_corr-mu_ref [mag]. No PV addition/subtraction; use released total C [mag²] once.
prespecified_mean.nuisance: One global additive magnitude intercept plus one high-bin offset. This is equivalent to two bin means and profiles calibration/mean level jointly with angular terms; neither bin mean estimates H0.
prespecified_mean.angular_design: Within each of the two disjoint bins,8 columns [n_x,n_y,n_z,n^T E1 n,...,n^T E5 n], with the H03 Frobenius basis and its signs. Full design2 nuisance+16 angular=18 columns. Parameters are apparent magnitude dipole/STF coefficients, not shear/acceleration.
prespecified_mean.depth_image: Report both signed8-vectors, their full16x16 covariance and high-minus-low8-vector using the exact covariance contrast, including cross-bin blocks. One combined16D primary test; binwise/contrast outputs descriptive unless a simultaneous testing rule is separately declared before use.

covariance_and_test.method: Cholesky-whiten released subset C once; profile nuisances by orthogonal projection; unit-column SVD. Rank primary1e-10 with1e-12/1e-8 spectrum sensitivity. Preserve cross-CID, survey and depth terms.
covariance_and_test.primary_statistic: DeltaT=T_null-T_full with rank difference r, under an explicitly stipulated fixed-design Gaussian released-total-covariance law. Report conditional chi-square_r upper-tail and nominal0.05 threshold only when rank/known-C premises hold. Do not rescale C to force reduced chi-square1, infer empirical source-population coverage or search a best direction after testing.
covariance_and_test.uncertainty: Coefficient covariance from the same GLS; simultaneous ellipsoid for identifiable angular subspace. Rank deficiency returns fitted observable image/nullspace, not unique coefficients.
covariance_and_test.precision: Finite and symmetric covariance; symmetry residual <=64*eps*N*maxabs(C). Require Cholesky PD or diagnose eigenmodes without jitter; any materially negative mode holds the fit. Float64 independent GLS/QR fixture rtol1e-9,atol1e-10 in dimensionless whitened quantities; column-order/unit invariance1e-10. Reference quadrature32 vs64 relative1e-10 for dimensionless integral, without ODE.
covariance_and_test.robustness_reporting: Compare primary and predeclared lower-z sensitivity on their distinct cohorts. They overlap and are correlated; differences are sensitivity, not independent confirmations. No old distance/20-fit experiment is rerun.

observer_chart_test.deterministic_conversion: At fixed released redshifts, m_star=m_b_corr-10log10(1+zHEL), mu_ref_star=mu_ref-10log10(1+zHEL). Transform both data and mean; residual y, selected covariance and fitted angular coefficients must remain unchanged to numerical tolerance. This is dL/(1+zHEL)^2 chart conversion conditional on released redshifts, not a new physical-frame fit.
observer_chart_test.physical_ceiling: A physical boost also changes redshift vertex, directions/aberration, distance response, selection and possibly uncertainty; use R36-04 chart before such interpretation. zHD already uses VPEC corrections, while zHEL is the observed redshift label; substituting zCMB or zHD for photon redshift in the correction requires a source-bound derivation. Do not add redshift/PV uncertainty again when already in C.
observer_chart_test.falsifier: Changing only data or only mean creates an artificial redshift-dependent residual; this inconsistent transformation must fail the equivalence test. No physical acceleration claim follows from apparent magnitudes.
